svg.aria-label: Install in three steps. 1, paste the prompt into Claude Code, Codex or Hermes Agent, at the root of your repository. 2, answer the interview: about 35 questions, one at a time, 30 to 45 minutes. 3, your GTM OS runs: context, skills, orchestration, integrations.
